name: Extract efficiency
plain_definition: The share of the extract in the grist that reached the fermenter.
formula: Extract in cast kg / theoretical extract in grist kg
source: Grist weights from the brew sheet; malt certificate from the lot; cast volume from `vessel_event`; gravity from the lab result

name: Wort volume yield
plain_definition: The hectolitres of wort cast for every 100 kg of grist.
formula: Cast hL / grist kg x 100; compare within one gravity
check_value: 300 / 5,300 x 100 = 5.66 hL per 100 kg at 12.0 degrees Plato

name: Cast gravity deviation
plain_definition: How far the cast gravity sits from the recipe.
formula: Cast degrees Plato - recipe degrees Plato
source: Lab result under the precedence rule; `recipe_version`
check_value: 12.0 - 12.0 = 0.0 degrees Plato on the lab figure (the meter figure gives +0.3)

name: Cast volume variance
plain_definition: How far the cast volume sits from the recipe volume.
formula: (Cast hL - recipe hL) / recipe hL
check_value: (104,500 / 350 - 300) / 300 = -0.48 percent, the yearly average

name: Apparent attenuation
plain_definition: The share of the original gravity that has fermented away, read from apparent extract.
formula: (OG - apparent extract) / OG

name: Cellar loss
plain_definition: The share of wort cast that does not leave the cellar.
formula: (Cast hL - hL sent to filtration) / cast hL
grain: fill; month is a sum over a sum

name: Filtration and bright tank loss
plain_definition: The share of wort cast lost between the filter and the bright tank.
formula: (hL into filter - hL into bright tank) / cast hL

name: Tank utilisation
plain_definition: The share of available fermenter days that held a fill, with turnaround.
formula: Days each fermenter held a fill, with turnaround / (tanks x days in period)
check_value: 4,658 / 5,475 = 85.1 percent for a year

name: Value in tank
plain_definition: The money tied up in beer in a tank, at the carried cost of its stage.
formula: hL in tank x carried cost per hL at that stage
check_value: 600 x 27 = 16,200 for one lager fill at the end of fermentation

name: Unexplained loss
plain_definition: The share of wort cast that the balance cannot place.
formula: (Cast - dispatched - known loss - change in stock) / cast hL; change in stock = closing tank hL - opening tank hL

name: OEE
plain_definition: How much of the planned time a line made good packs at rated speed.
formula: Availability x performance x quality. Availability is run time over planned time; performance is actual count over the count at rated speed; quality is good over total
check_value: 78.5 x 86.4 x 99.7 = 67.6 percent on the companion slice, all line shifts

name: Line speed loss
plain_definition: The share of rated output that a line did not make.
formula: 1 - (packs made / (run time x rated speed))
check_value: 1 - 28,800 / 36,000 = 20 percent against nameplate

name: Beer loss per hL packed
plain_definition: The litres lost in fills, rejects and flush for each hL packed.
formula: Litres lost in fills, rejects and flush / hL packed
check_value: 87 hL on 8,352 hL packed = 1.04 litres per hL

name: Reject rate
plain_definition: The share of filled packs that were rejected.
formula: Rejected packs / packs filled
check_value: 774 / 284,454 = 0.27 percent on the companion slice

name: Fill giveaway
plain_definition: The beer inside the pack above the declared volume.
formula: Mean (measured fill - declared fill) in ml
check_value: 4 ml on a 330 ml can, about 1.2 percent

name: Right first time
plain_definition: The share of batches that passed every spec on the first test.
formula: Batches that pass every spec on first test / batches tested
check_value: 2 of 3 fills = 66.7 percent on the companion slice; F08-26-035 failed bitterness on its first test

name: Hold rate
plain_definition: The share of finished batches placed on hold.
formula: Batches placed on hold / batches completed
source: A hold record. `batch` in C.1 has no hold column, so add one or load the QA hold log before this entry goes live
check_value: Set once the hold record is loaded

name: Spec compliance
plain_definition: The share of results inside their spec.
formula: Results inside spec / results tested
check_value: 26 / 26 current results = 100.0 percent on the companion slice

name: Complaints per million packs
plain_definition: How many complaints arrive for each million packs dispatched.
formula: Complaints / packs dispatched x 1,000,000
source: The QA complaint log (`bronze_qa_complaint`); packs dispatched from `movement` (ship) joined to `package_unit`
check_value: 1 / 183,840 x 1,000,000 = 5.44 for April 2026 on the companion slice

name: Mock recall time
plain_definition: The minutes from a lot code to a signed pallet list.
formula: Minutes from lot code to a signed pallet list
check_value: Target set by QA before the first drill (ch. 9.6)
